interpretation_scope: Tests topology-specific localization information for the single DS1 record; it does not test generalization to unseen damage locations.
selection_warning: DS1 was selected after the broader DS1-DS8 exploratory analysis because it is the only state with a unique represented ground-truth edge.

protocol.external_negative_control: all fourteen UDS02 blocks, unseen in fitting
protocol.test_record: all fourteen DS1 blocks, unseen in fitting and tuning
protocol.primary_test: one record-level mean-reciprocal-rank statistic compared against whole-record graph-label permutations
protocol.independence_claim: blocks are repeated estimates within one record, not independent damage experiments

graph_label_permutation_control.scheme: permute sensor labels within AG/AL families; preserve graph topology, edge weights, relation rows, degree sequence, and the complete DS1 record
graph_label_permutation_control.primary_statistic: record-level mean reciprocal rank of AL14-AL18

modal_subset_sensitivity.note: The cache contains three fitted modal bands; subsets test modal-band sensitivity, not re-estimation from different raw frequency windows.

consecutive_decision_aggregation_sensiti.note: Aggregates existing 60-second decisions; it is not a raw-data block-length re-extraction audit.
